title: AUHIP local brain scorecard
purpose: Repeatable manual checks for memory recall, source separation, tool selection, and local-only behavior.
setup: Use a disposable AUHIP data directory or back up existing local memory before changing fixtures.
Set CLOUD_ENABLED=false and verify no cloud request occurs during the local cases.
Install the configured embedding model with Ollama for semantic retrieval; lexical fallback should still work when embeddings are unavailable.
Record pass/fail and the returned source labels for every case. Do not score a plausible answer as a pass unless its source is correct.

cases.prompt: Remember that I prefer concise voice replies.
pass: A durable preference is saved with a stable memory ID, source=user, date, and confidence=1.0.
The confirmation says it was stored locally.
An ordinary unrelated exchange is not added to durable memory.

cases.prompt: What did I decide about AUHIP's first coding-agent integration?

seed.text: Start AUHIP coding-agent integration with the Antigravity CLI, then add Codex app-server support.

pass: The matching decision is returned with its memory ID and source.
Conversation history, second-brain documents, and task receipts are not presented as personal memories.
Unrelated or weak matches are omitted.

cases.prompt: Find the nearest database systems assignment deadline.
pass: AUHIP searches the second-brain/document lane or the structured deadlines tool.
The answer identifies the exact source file or structured deadline record.
No project-guidance memory or agent receipt is substituted for the user-owned deadline source.

cases.prompt: Ask Antigravity to inspect this workspace and summarize the failing login flow.
pass: The dispatch confirmation is shown before the CLI starts.
The selected workspace is within configured sandbox roots and Antigravity sandbox mode is enabled.
The completion appears in task history by receipt, not as a durable personal memory.

cases.prompt: Use Gemini to summarize this paragraph: local-only check.
pass: With CLOUD_ENABLED=false, AUHIP clearly says cloud is disabled and sends nothing externally.
With CLOUD_ENABLED=true, only this current prompt is sent; saved memories and prior turns are excluded.
Without an explicit cloud request, low confidence or local failure never triggers cloud fallback.
